backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing comment list management with customer-facing endpoints (getAvailableCommentLists, getCommentListSummary, generateSingleComment, generateBulkComments) and admin functions for creating/managing comment lists with role-based authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence bugs in AdminCommentsTab: a button click handler issue and a select dropdown change event handler issue, both mapped to test requirements REQ-1 and REQ-2.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including pages for comment generation (single/bulk/live checker), admin panel with token gate, and various UI components with animations and styling details.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including sidebar, chart, and UI component color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx, titled 'APP REVIEW'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring React Query, theme provider, and TanStack Router with routes for customer view, upload section, live list checker, and admin panel (protected by AdminTokenGate).
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminChatT: Admin UI component for managing chat messages with form inputs for sender/message, send functionality, and a scrollable message history display with timestamps.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminComme: Admin UI component for managing comment lists with functionality to create lists, add comments (bulk or single), delete comments, reset lists, and view bulk comment totals.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminImage: Admin UI component that displays a grid of uploaded rating images with metadata (uploader name, timestamp) and provides delete functionality for each image.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLiveL: Admin UI component for managing live list apps and usernames, supporting app creation/deletion, bulk or comma-separated username addition, and reset functionality for individual apps or all apps.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSetti: Admin UI component for managing the bulk generator access key, displaying current key status with masked value, and providing set/reset key functionality.
frontend/src/components/AdminTokenGate.t: Authorization guard component that checks admin token validity and displays access denied card with ShieldAlert icon if unauthorized, or renders children if authorized.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackdrop: Empty file placeholder for canvas-based animated background component.
Empty file placeholder for glassmorphism audio player component.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Empty file placeholder for authentication/authorization wrapper component.
frontend/src/components/EffectBurst.tsx: Empty file placeholder for visual effects component (hearts, confetti, sparkles).
frontend/src/components/GalleryGrid.tsx: Empty file placeholder for responsive gallery grid component.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Empty file placeholder for Internet Identity login/logout button component.
frontend/src/components/Rotating3DObject: Component rendering a 3D rotating cube with six colored faces using CSS transforms and animations.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Empty file placeholder for footer component with copyright and Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Root layout component with fixed background image overlay, TopSegmentedNav header, main content outlet, and footer with Caffeine.ai attribution and UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/SiteNav.tsx: Empty file placeholder for responsive navigation component.
frontend/src/components/TeddyMascot.tsx: Empty file placeholder for teddy bear mascot component with animations.
Sticky top navigation with segmented buttons for Customer View, Upload Section, Live List Checker, and conditionally-rendered Admin Panel (based on admin token), showing active state with gradient styling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing with admin token from URL parameters and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminComments.ts: React Query hooks for admin comment list management including fetching available lists, creating lists, adding single comments, bulk uploading comments, and managing comment totals with proper cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminToken.ts: Custom hook for managing admin authentication via a hardcoded token stored in session storage, checking URL hash parameters and providing admin access state.
frontend/src/hooks/useBulkGeneratorKey.t: React Query hooks for managing bulk generator API key status, including checking if a key exists, setting a new key, and resetting the key with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatMessages.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all chat messages and adding new chat messages with sender information, invalidating the cache on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: React Query hooks for comment generation functionality including fetching available lists, getting list summaries, checking bulk key status, and generating single or bulk comments with device-based restrictions and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and providing AuthClient configuration with delegation identity handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveListChecker.ts: React Query hooks for managing live list apps and checking usernames against them, including admin operations like adding apps, managing usernames, and resetting data.
frontend/src/hooks/useRatingImages.ts: React Query hooks for managing rating images including uploading with uploader name, fetching all images, and deleting images by index with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes using OKLCH color space, utility classes for pastel backgrounds, cards, buttons, and 3D rotating cube animations.
frontend/src/lib/deviceId.ts: Provides utilities for generating and storing a stable device identifier in localStorage, and tracking which comment lists have been used for single-generation on the current device.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin panel page with tabbed interface for managing comments, images, chat, live lists, and settings with corresponding tab components.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerViewPage.tsx: Customer-facing page for generating single or bulk comments from selected lists, with device-based single-generation restrictions and admin access code entry.
frontend/src/pages/LiveListCheckerPage.t: Page for checking usernames against selected live list apps, with localStorage persistence for selections and results, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSectionPage.tsx: Page for uploading rating images with uploader name, featuring progress tracking and success feedback using ExternalBlob for file handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, and plugins for animations and typography.
project_state.json: Project state tracking fixes for two non-functional UI elements in AdminCommentsTab: a button that should create a comment list and a select dropdown that should trigger actions on change. Both features are marked as fix requests with version 1.
